name.value: Loon Lake Lodge and Retreat Centre

description.value: Operated by the University of British Columbia, Loon Lake Lodge & Retreat Centre is a year-round retreat and conference destination tucked inside the Malcolm Knapp Research Forest, less than an hour east of Vancouver. The property can accommodate up to 195 guests across several distinct buildings ranging from Whistler-style lodge facilities to dormitory-style student housing. A touring cyclist looking for a remote forest setting with on-site dining and multiple accommodation tiers would find this a distinctive overnight option near Golden Ears Provincial Park.

address.value: 14500 Silver Valley Road, Maple Ridge, V4R 2R3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is live and detailed. WiFi is explicitly confirmed in multiple facility descriptions ('conference room with modern AV equipment and WiFi', 'Each bedroom has 1 bunk bed, 1 single bed, a writing desk, and WiFi'). No mention of bicycle storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The contact page body matches OSM address and phone (604-463-8148), but the website footer also lists a different number (+16044638149) which may be a secondary or typo variant.
concerns: Website footer lists a slightly different phone number (+16044638149) versus the main contact page and OSM value (+1-604-463-8148) — likely a typo (last digit 9 vs 8) but worth verifying.
OSM name uses 'and' ('Loon Lake Lodge and Retreat Centre') while the website consistently uses '&' ('Loon Lake Lodge & Retreat Centre') — minor discrepancy.

Facility operates primarily on a group-booking model (corporate retreats, school groups, wellness weekends); walk-in or individual overnight bookings are not explicitly offered, which may limit usability for solo touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational, publicly bookable accommodation in a notable wilderness setting operated by UBC. Actively markets group and retreat bookings year-round.
